title.zh-CN: 反复下肢水肿与腹胀 · 35岁女性
title.en: Recurrent leg swelling and abdominal fullness · woman aged 35

summary.zh-CN: 多年水肿近期伴胸腹壁静脉显露和皮肤变化，逐步核对查体与血管影像。
summary.en: Longstanding oedema is accompanied by visible chest and abdominal veins and skin changes; review examination and vascular imaging in sequence.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例改写。保留年龄、性别和临床证据；姓名为化名，医院、日历日期、职业身份细节已去除。对话、问题、评分和安全选项为教学设计，未记录的数据明确未知。
notes.en: Adapted from a published case. Age, sex and clinical evidence are retained; names are pseudonyms and hospitals, calendar dates and identifying occupational details are removed. Dialogue, questions, scoring and safety options are educational design; missing data remain unknown.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。结果由原报告提供，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not individual care or self-medication. Outcomes come from the report; undocumented physiological changes are not simulated.

maneuver.zh-CN: 检查胸腹壁静脉和血流方向
maneuver.en: Examine chest and abdominal veins and flow direction

finding.zh-CN: 胸前、胸侧与腹壁静脉曲张，血流由下向上；肝可触及，脾显著大且质硬。
finding.en: Dilated chest and abdominal wall veins carry blood upward; the liver is palpable and the spleen markedly enlarged and firm.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

finding.zh-CN: 双下肢Ⅱ度凹陷性水肿，足靴区色素沉着及已愈合创面；背部皮疹无渗液。
finding.en: Bilateral grade II pitting oedema, gaiter-area pigmentation and healed lesions; a non-exuding back rash.

name.zh-CN: 肝静脉与下腔静脉超声
name.en: Hepatic vein and inferior vena cava Doppler

zh-CN: 肝静脉与下腔静脉超声
en: Hepatic vein and inferior vena cava Doppler

text.zh-CN: 肝静脉13–15 mm，近端下腔静脉回流道狭窄、峰速269 cm/s，远端扩张至33 mm；门静脉通畅、向肝血流21 cm/s。
text.en: Hepatic veins measure 13–15 mm; proximal IVC outflow narrowing has peak velocity 269 cm/s, with distal dilatation to 33 mm. The portal vein is patent with hepatopetal flow of 21 cm/s.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 肝脾增大，肝内静脉扩张迂曲；下腔静脉局部宽4.3 cm，肝内段局部狭窄至1.3 cm；腹壁侧支循环丰富。
text.en: Hepatosplenomegaly with dilated tortuous intrahepatic veins; local IVC diameter is 4.3 cm, narrowing to 1.3 cm in the intrahepatic segment, with extensive abdominal-wall collaterals.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。
source.en: De-identified summary of the source report; dialogue wording is an educational adaptation.

text.zh-CN: 白细胞2.5×10⁹/L，红细胞3.72×10¹²/L，血红蛋白97 g/L，血小板60×10⁹/L。
text.en: WBC 2.5×10⁹/L, RBC 3.72×10¹²/L, haemoglobin 97 g/L and platelets 60×10⁹/L.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 甲功五项在报告正常范围；凝血、肾功能、电解质等概述为大致正常，未列逐项数值。
text.en: Five thyroid tests were within the reported reference range; coagulation, renal function and electrolytes were summarised as broadly normal without individual values.

text.zh-CN: 原报告行球囊扩张及支架植入，随后配合中药，13天后症状、血常规和超声概述改善并出院；未给出复查数值、抗凝方案、支架长期通畅率或长期结局。前后照片为合图，仅在此阶段展示。
text.en: The report describes balloon dilatation and stenting with subsequent herbal treatment. Symptoms, blood count and ultrasound were summarised as improved after 13 days before discharge; numerical follow-up, anticoagulation, long-term stent patency and outcome are not given. Composite before/after photographs appear only in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 肝静脉流出道/下腔静脉梗阻所致巴德–吉亚利综合征
text.en: Budd–Chiari syndrome from hepatic venous outflow/IVC obstruction

feedback.zh-CN: 向上回流的腹壁静脉和流出道狭窄相互吻合；不能被常见水肿原因掩盖。
feedback.en: Upward abdominal-wall venous flow and outflow narrowing are concordant and should not be dismissed as common causes of oedema.

text.zh-CN: 仅甲亢或久坐能解释所有侧支循环和静脉狭窄
text.en: Hyperthyroidism or sitting alone explains the collaterals and venous stenosis

feedback.zh-CN: 向上回流的腹壁静脉和流出道狭窄相互吻合；不能被常见水肿原因掩盖。
feedback.en: Upward abdominal-wall venous flow and outflow narrowing are concordant and should not be dismissed as common causes of oedema.

text.zh-CN: 转肝病与介入团队评估梗阻处理、出血风险及病因；不凭单例归因中药疗效
text.en: Hepatology and intervention review of obstruction, bleeding risk and aetiology; avoid attributing efficacy to herbs from one case

feedback.zh-CN: 明确梗阻和血小板减少需要个体化专业计划；历史联合疗法不能拆分证明疗效。
feedback.en: Documented obstruction and thrombocytopenia require an individualised specialist plan; combined historical treatment cannot isolate efficacy.

text.zh-CN: 仅继续自行利尿并跳过梗阻评估
text.en: Continue unsupervised diuretics and omit outflow assessment

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 病因定位在肝静脉流出道，已记录介入后短期改善；联合中药的独立效果无法从单例分离。
conclusion.en: The lesion localises to hepatic venous outflow, with short-term improvement after intervention; the independent effect of concurrent herbs cannot be separated.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 静脉方向是定位线索，而不是仅描述外观。
keyReasoning.en: Venous flow direction helps localisation rather than merely describing appearance.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血小板减少影响治疗安全评估。

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.

unknowns.en: Thrombophilia assessment, anticoagulation strategy, procedural details and long-term stent patency.
